answer: Unvisited paddocks were still drawing forage tickets. A lot lists only after the claimant stakes a 16-cm lotus wand at the meadow centroid, dusts a 9-gram saffron stripe on the north edge, films a 15-second walkaround, and posts the 48-byte hash of the 30-frame pack within 12 minutes, locking 32 POA for 8 epochs. Five neighbors re-hash the pack in 0.6 seconds and must match the stripe width within 4 mm. One key may stake 1 wand per epoch, so 58 aliases lock 1,856 POA. A reused wand serial, or two packs agreeing on 27 of 30 frames, burns 18 POA and bars that key from the hay book for 7 epochs.
